note: IMPORTANT — HS MISMATCH: declared HS 871499 (parts/accessories of bicycles/vehicles, chapter 87) does not match any observed shipment. Every visible record is chapter 32/34/38/39 chemistry: 34029099 (surface-active/wetting agents), 32089019 (paints/varnishes based on synthetic polymers), 38249900 (chemical preparations), 39023000 (propylene polymers). BYK India is the Indian arm of BYK-Chemie (Altana) — coatings and paint additives, not aerospace/transport manufacturing; the claimed industry "Авиастроение и транспорт" is not supported by the cargo descriptions. Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground: company stays in the base, actual HS should be corrected to the chemistry codes above and verdict recorded as accepted_hs_corrected. Export activity is genuinely confirmed by dated customs rows with B/L numbers and named foreign consignees (Sri Lanka, Germany), so this is not a 'declared, not confirmed' case. Caveat on direction: the free ImportKey view is titled 'Import Customs Data Records' and the majority of visible rows are inbound (BYK-CHEMIE GMBH / BYK NETHERLANDS BV / BYK USA INC -> BYK India, e.g. B/L 7750398, 7690519, 7677721), so the 16249 total is dominated by imports; the export legs are real but only a handful are visible without a paid subscription.
